scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A graying, bearded man cries with his face raised in a sunlit city street. Ashes cover his hair and coarse brown sackcloth over a cream robe. scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Mordecai’s sackcloth, ashes, torn garment and anguished cry bring the verse’s successive actions into one imagined moment in the city.
